major_work.title: Liquidity Vacuum vs Demand Surge Decomposition
major_work.question: When price advances sharply, can observable microstructure distinguish aggressive demand expansion from temporary offer-side liquidity withdrawal without inferring hidden actor intent?
major_work.motivation: Equal price returns can arise from very different market mechanics. A thin offer book/liquidity vacuum can create a fast rise with weak durable demand, while persistent aggressive demand can absorb replenished offers. Treating both as the same breakout strength can create false confidence.
observables: signed aggressive trade imbalance where authoritative tick/quote data exists
spread and quoted-depth change before/during/after impulse
market/sector residual return and volatility regime
safety_contracts: Do not label any state as accumulation, distribution, manipulation, or a specific actor's intent.
If authoritative point-in-time quote/trade evidence is unavailable, emit UNKNOWN rather than proxying with candle shape alone.
Do not treat displayed order-book depth as committed future liquidity; cancellations and hidden liquidity are competing explanations.
All features and peer controls must be available as-of decision time.
No production probability until validated samples and calibration exist.
baselines: EXP-E-003 counterfactual relative response when available

tests: mechanism-label reliability study before predictive testing
ablation: replenishment, spread/depth, turnover persistence, retention, residual strength
regime segmentation by liquidity and volatility
calibration and coverage-vs-error including UNKNOWN abstention
incremental-value comparison against simple impact/turnover baseline
kill_criteria: no out-of-sample incremental value over simple impact/turnover baseline
quote/trade timestamps cannot be aligned point-in-time
mechanism labels are too noisy or observer-dependent for reproducible validation
benefit does not justify tick/quote data and maintenance cost

checks: audit quote/trade provenance and as-of chronology
challenge displayed-depth interpretation using cancellation/hidden-liquidity alternatives
reject causal language that attributes observed mechanism to a hidden actor

sre_handoff.only_if_promoted: Provide freshness/provenance/alignment metadata for authoritative tick and quote snapshots; do not build new pipeline before validation need is established.

major_work.relation_to_existing: Distinct from inventory/distribution estimates, EXP-E-003 matched-control residual response, ARCH-E-001 routing, and ARCH-E-002 uncertainty composition. This challenger targets the observable mechanism behind an impulse move.
